concept.title: Mentoring, coaching and qualifications
concept.shortdesc: Guidance and development services such as mentoring, coaching and working towards formal qualifications and awards.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : One-to-one or peer mentoring where an experienced person guides and supports someone, including volunteer mentor schemes and business mentors.
: Coaching sessions and short coaching courses, such as career, job, recovery or money coaching, to help someone reach goals.
: Working towards or earning formal qualifications, awards and accredited certificates, such as vocational awards, A levels or Duke of Edinburgh.
